content: स्मरणम् [स्मृ-ल्युट्] .²1 Remembering, remembrance, recollection; केवलं स्मरणेनैव पुनासि पुरुषं यतः <ls>R. 10. 29</ls>. .²2 Thinking of or about; यदि हरिस्मरणे सरसं मनः <ls>Gīt. 1</ls>. .²3 Memory. .²4 Tradition, traditional precept; इति भृगुस्मरणात् (<ab>opp.</ab> श्रुति). .²5 Mental recitation of the name of a deity. .²6 Remembering with regret, regretting. .²7 Rhetorical recollection, regarded as a figure of speech; thus defined:-- यथानुभवमर्थस्य दृष्टे तत्सदृशे स्मृतिः स्मरणम् <ls>K. P. 10</ls>. .{@-णी@} A rosary of beads (for counting).
